newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet pressured by glut, IPE backwardation.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet pressured by glut, IPE backwardation.

text.p: LONDON, Feb 4 Reuter) - European Jet fuel premiums to gas oil futures were under pressure on Tuesday as buyers in NWE and the Mediterranean stayed scarce, brokers said.
They said the combination of both Med and transatlantic arrivals and the steep near $10 backwardation to March on the IPE gas oil futures was keeping buyers relaxed.
"The next cif cargo could get done at a low -- very low number off the (IPE) March contract," one trader said.
Traders said cif cargo sellers were reluctant to offer into the void of buying interest and levels for prompt deliveries were hard to pin down.
FOB barge sellers were notionally around Feb IPE +$26-27 a tonne but here again buying interest was very thin.
Buying into Scandinavia was thought covered and demand into the U.K. market, apart from some light buying into Belfast was muted.
Brokers said Mediterranean markets were looking very long and many sellers were eyeing arbitrage options.
Firm Far East markets were the main focus of this attention, but many traders expected the demand to initially be filled out of the Mideast Gulf.
They said Libyan barrels were asking around cif high $2 a tonne with E.C. material asking around cif high +$4-5 a tonne cif Med.
